----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Venkat Poonia For Respondent(s) : Mr. A.R. Choudhary, PP
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE FARJAND ALI Order 16/05/2024 1.
The jurisdiction of this Court has been invoked by way of filing an application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. at the instance of accused-petitioner.

The requisite details of the matter are tabulated herein below:
S.No. Particulars of the Case  2.
Concerned Police Station Ghamoodwali

3. District Ganga Nagar  4. Offences alleged in the FIR Under Sections 376(2)(n)
 & 384 of IPC and Section 67A of IT Act  5. Offences added, if any -- 6. Date of passing of impugned 04.05.2024 order 2.
It is contended on behalf of the accused-petitioner that no case for the alleged offences is made out against him and his incarceration is not warranted.

There are no factors at play in Bhimsen vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:22260) on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/87242388/
1 [2024:RJ-JD:22260] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-5823/2024] the case at hand that may work against grant of bail to the accused-petitioner and he has been made an accused based on conjectures and surmises.
3.

Contrary to the submissions of learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Public Prosecutor opposes the bail application and submits that the present case is not fit for enlargement of accused on bail.
4. I have considered the submissions made by both the parties and have perused the material available on record.
5. The victim is a married lady, aged about 21 years.
She lodged the FIR on 19.01.2024 alleging interalia the petitioner is her neighbour and around one year ago she was called at his home where nobody was present except the petitioner.
She was taken into the room and where after subjected to rape.

She alleges that the scene of her compromising situation had been videographed and so she was threatened by the petitioner to not to disclose the fact of rape to anyone lest he would make the video viral.
She alleges that on several occasions, she was seduced on account of threat of making the video viral.
On 16.01.2024, the accused-petitioner showed the video of the victim to her father-in-law which led to lodging of the FIR.

A perusal of report under Section 173 Cr.P.C revealing that no video was made viral by the petitioner although it is mentioned that the mobile has been destroyed and it is the reason that the same could not be recovered.

After going through her statement and the other material available on record; the age of the victim, the [2024:RJ-JD:22260]
(3 of 3) [CRLMB-5823/2024] manner in which the incident took place as well as the fact that for a considerable long time the victim kept mum by not disclosing the fact of seducement to any person as well as taking into account that the charge-sheet has been filed.
In light of these facts and circumstances, it is deemed suitable to grant the benefit of bail to the petitioner in the present matter.

6. Accordingly, the instant bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner as named in the cause title shall be enlarged on bail provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.

(FARJAND ALI),J 51-Samvedana/-
